title: with no mcp list a server must be named in the project's .mcp.json; without that file no server exists
source: intended: docs/decisions.md, Only launches are blocked, and launches into other repositories (allowlists are open unless a list restricts)
intent: Open does not mean unchecked: a typo fails validation instead of failing in the terminal.

files..jitso/drafts/present.yaml:
id: present
version: 1
status: draft
role: operator
type: scanner
description: Scan the repo.
harness: claude
model: any-vendor/any-model
effort: extreme
skills_first: []
mcp: [dbhub, unlisted]
